architecture: ChatGPT subscription + Grass Blasters skills + Zapier MCP. A custom Grass Blasters MCP server is optional later.
principle: The web UI and ChatGPT use the same risk rules even when Zapier MCP performs the action.

execution.v1: Zapier MCP calls Jobber and Zapier Tables directly from ChatGPT.
execution.dashboard: POST /api/tools/execute forwards approved requests to a Zapier action webhook.
execution.future: Expose composite tools through a private Grass Blasters MCP server only when repeated multi-call workflows justify it.
